name: Goldsky Resources Corp.
summary: Goldsky Resources Corp. is a junior exploration company that acquires, explores and develops mineral properties in Sweden and Finland, looking for zinc, uranium, lead, copper, silver, gold and iron ore. A 45% stake is its primary venture in the Barsele Gold Project in northern Sweden, that being Incorporated in 2013 as Barsele Minerals Corp., it is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
